limitations: The name `__class__` is excluded because Python’s Data model describes an implicit class closure reference.
An intervening function’s global declaration can make a farther function-local binding unavailable. Module globals and ordinary class attributes do not supply function-local bindings.
The lexical binding rule does not require the variable already to have a runtime value when the declaration is parsed.
